observations: L01: the last letter of الصابئ is a dotless yā' with hamza above (ئ in its final form).

L05: نُقِلَ has a damma over the nūn (above its dot), a kasra under the qāf and a fatha over the lām (1400 dpi); الإِسْكوريال has under the alif the hamza with its kasra in one sort and a sukun over the sīn.
L03, L04, L05, L09: the long joins of the display type (عبــد, محــمّــد, المعــروف, عــن, النسخــة, طبــع) are not transcribed.
L05, L07: the kāf of بمكتبة, الدكتور and كَرْلو has the long swash form (ڪ), transcribed ك.
L09: طُبع has a damma over the ṭā'; under the bā' only its dot.

L05: the mark under the alif of الإِسْكوريال measures 3.2-3.5 x 4.7 pt: the hamza with its kasra cast in one sort, the sort of the text type (3.4-3.6 x 4.6-5.0 pt on p. 41; a bare hamza under an alif measures 3.2 x 3.3 pt). In the master scan the hamza and the stroke run together; in the second copy the stroke of the kasra stands clear under the hamza, as under the alif of وإِن on p. 41 (found by tools_s10/kasrasweep.py).
